$comment: Repository settings every repository with the topic kheona-skill must have, read only by scripts/kskill-repo-settings.sh. Entries apply in order, a later one overriding an earlier one with the same key; `api` `label` declares a label that must exist (created if missing, never edited or deleted); `api` `variable` declares an Actions variable whose value `derive` (a jq expression over .kheona.json, $repo and $fork bound) gives, "" meaning it must not exist; `when` narrows an entry to forks ({"fork": true}) or to roles ({"role": [...]}, from .kheona.json). A repository overrides a key in its .kheona.json `settings` ({"<key>": {"value": <v>, "why": "..."}}; value null leaves the key unmanaged there). Free plans only: nothing here needs a paid plan (no branch protection, rulesets, org secrets or native auto-merge).

settings.why: Kheona Skill · PR (its merge job) and Kheona Skill · Release squash-merge (gh pr merge --squash).
A library is released by release-please from main's commits: one Conventional Commit per PR, the squash title.
As allow_merge_commit: a rebase merge puts every commit of the PR on main, each read by release-please.
A fork's upstream sync PR (chore/sync-upstream) is merged with a merge commit: squashing it loses the parent's history, so the fork stays behind  and the next sync conflicts.

Automation branches (kskill/sync, chore/bump-lib, chore/sync-upstream...) are recreated on each run; GitHub retargets PRs stacked on a branch it deletes this way, and never deletes the default branch.
The update-branch button on a PR behind its base (the doctor's remedy is gh pr update-branch).
Documentation lives in the repository; no repository had a wiki page (2026-10-23).
Every kskill-* template runs in GitHub Actions.
Least privilege: every template declares its own permissions and writes with the GitHub App's token.
No template opens or approves a PR with GITHUB_TOKEN (a PR it opened would start no CI): the GitHub App's token does.

Dependabot is off: Renovate opens a PR per known vulnerability from OSV (osvVulnerabilityAlerts, kheona-skill renovate/default.json), CI audits the locked transitives. Dependabot's alerts fed only those PRs, and its jobs on them failed where it lags a runtime (Python 3.15).

One bot opens dependency PRs: Renovate, security fixes included (OSV, vulnerabilityAlerts in kheona-skill renovate/default.json), with the same policy as every update. Turned off before the alerts: GitHub refuses the alerts off while the updates are on.

settings.derive: if (.workflows.cd | type) != "object" then "" elif (.workflows.cd.templateRepository // "") == $repo or .workflows.cd.staging == false or .workflows.cd.enabled == false then "false" else "" end
settings.why: The staging deploy of Kheona Skill · Main (kskill-main.yml calls kskill-deploy.yml on a push to main): off in a template (workflows.cd.templateRepository), where workflows.cd.staging is false or workflows.cd.enabled is false. Written from .kheona.json ("false" where the switch is off, absent otherwise), so the job-level `if:` skips it before any runner starts: a started job bills at least a minute on a private repository. Unset, the deploy starts and reads .kheona.json as before.

Written from .kheona.json ("false" where the switch is off, absent otherwise), so the job-level `if:` skips it before any runner starts: a started job bills at least a minute on a private repository. settings.derive: if (.workflows.cd | type) != "object" and .role != "template" then "" elif .workflows.release.enabled == false or .workflows.cd.enabled == false or .role == "library" or ((.workflows.cd.templateRepository // "") == $repo) or (.role == "template" and ($fork | not)) or .workflows.cd.prod == false then "false" else "" end
settings.why: The release PR jobs (actions/kskill-release-pr, in kskill-main.yml, kskill-ship.yml and the inbox's release-pr job): off where .github/scripts/kskill-release.sh skips by configuration (workflows.release.enabled or workflows.cd.enabled false, role library, a template outside a fork, workflows.cd.prod false). Written from .kheona.json ("false" where the switch is off, absent otherwise), so the template's job-level `if:` skips the run before any runner starts: a started job bills at least a minute on a private repository. Unset, the workflow starts and reads .kheona.json as before.
Retired 2026-10-26 (it must not exist): the Node CI has no standalone push run left, kskill-main.yml calls the gate once per push to main. Was: off where workflows.ci.runOnPush was false.

The dist rebuild of Kheona Skill · PR (kskill-pr.yml jobs dist-build and dist-commit): on where .kheona.json workflows.distRebuild is set (a repository that commits its build output, a library's dist/). Written from .kheona.json ("true" where it is set, absent otherwise), so the jobs are skipped before any runner starts everywhere else.

The merge job of Kheona Skill · PR (kskill-pr.yml): off where workflows.automerge.enabled is false (a merge to the default branch deploys production). Written from .kheona.json ("false" where the switch is off, absent otherwise), so the template's job-level `if:` skips the run before any runner starts: a started job bills at least a minute on a private repository. Unset, the workflow starts and reads .kheona.json as before.
